issues.title: [Bug] A skipped-role notice between two replies merges them into one turn, hiding the earlier finished answer inside Activity

en.headline: One issue comment on openchamber; 5 automated commits in personal repo
en.summary: On 2026-10-12 the user had no own commits, pull requests, reviews, or releases. The only activity was commenting on issue #4664 in `openchamber/openchamber`, titled "[Bug] A skipped-role notice between two replies merges them into one turn, hiding the earlier finished answer inside Activity". Separately, `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` recorded **5** automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`, with no user-authored commit messages. No discussions, stars, state changes, or replies were logged for the day.
